title: Douyin Fashion Commerce Storyboard
subtitle: 25-panel apparel-selling board for a vertical short-video host

panels.label: Hook frame
panels.caption: Start with instant product attention and host energy.
panels.prompt: host points to camera, strong outfit reveal, first 3 seconds, same protagonist

panels.label: Front hero
panels.caption: Clean full-body front view to prove silhouette.
panels.prompt: full-body front hero, truthful garment shape, clean studio lighting

panels.label: 3/4 pose
panels.caption: Turn slightly to show dimension without hiding the fit.
panels.prompt: 3/4 body pose, elegant host smile, same dress, same boots

panels.label: Side silhouette
panels.caption: Show the side profile and drape behavior.
panels.prompt: side view silhouette, fashion-selling clarity, truthful waist and hemline

panels.label: Back silhouette
panels.caption: Prove the product from the back.
panels.prompt: back view, garment back detail, same colorway, same host

panels.label: Walking approach
panels.caption: Move toward the camera to make the cloth feel alive.
panels.prompt: walking toward camera, dynamic hem movement, same host

panels.label: Fabric movement
panels.caption: Focus on swing, weight, and comfort.
panels.prompt: fabric swing in motion, premium texture, same product truth

panels.label: Neckline detail
panels.caption: Tight detail on collar or neckline construction.
panels.prompt: close-up neckline detail, premium knit texture, realistic stitches

panels.label: Sleeve detail
panels.caption: Show sleeve texture and finish.
panels.prompt: cuff and sleeve close-up, hand lifting sleeve slightly, truthful textile

panels.label: Waist fit
panels.caption: Show how the garment shapes the body.
panels.prompt: waist fit detail, flattering body line, same product

panels.label: Hem movement
panels.caption: Demonstrate movement and fall of the hem.
panels.prompt: hem swing close-medium shot, movement proof, same dress

panels.label: Pocket or zipper
panels.caption: Feature one functional detail or closure.
panels.prompt: zipper or pocket detail, hands interacting naturally, product truth

panels.label: Lifestyle seat
panels.caption: Show the product in a relaxed lifestyle beat.
panels.prompt: host seated casually, elegant smile, same garment and room

panels.label: Dance energy
panels.caption: Inject social-video energy without losing product clarity.
panels.prompt: small dance-like motion, playful host, same outfit, product still readable

panels.label: Turn-around
panels.caption: Catch the garment mid-turn for dynamic proof.
panels.prompt: turn-around midpoint, motion-rich frame, same host, same dress

panels.label: Smile hero
panels.caption: Closer emotional shot for trust and charisma.
panels.prompt: medium close-up, smile to camera, premium seller energy

panels.label: Mirror angle
panels.caption: A mirror or selfie angle for social-native credibility.
panels.prompt: mirror selfie style angle, same garment, still premium and clean

panels.label: Texture hero
panels.caption: Bring the fabric very close for tactile appeal.
panels.prompt: macro textile hero, knit texture visible, luxury lighting

panels.label: Styling A
panels.caption: Show one alternate styling combination.
panels.prompt: same base dress with styling variation A, same protagonist, same product truth

panels.label: Styling B
panels.caption: Show a second styling option for versatility.
panels.prompt: same base dress with styling variation B, handbag or outer layer

panels.label: Layering proof
panels.caption: Demonstrate layering compatibility.
panels.prompt: layered outerwear or accessory, same dress visible, commerce clarity

panels.label: Live-room energy
panels.caption: Let the frame feel like a winning short-video seller moment.
panels.prompt: high-energy seller pose, inviting gesture, same product, same host

panels.label: Close hero
panels.caption: Bring the garment and host close together in a premium hero shot.
panels.prompt: close hero with dress details near camera, warm seller expression

panels.label: Clean reset
panels.caption: Return to a clean front view before the close.
panels.prompt: front hero reset, polished silhouette, clear garment shape

panels.label: CTA finish
panels.caption: End with a frame that supports call-to-action copy.
panels.prompt: final CTA-ready host pose, premium smile, same dress, strong product visibility
